checkpoint_comparison: The three public Exp1 generations use one common final-evaluation play profile; this does not claim each generation's original training-time profile.
derivation: run_config_snapshot.jvm supplies 96 visits and timeout_ms=12000. gen33.settings supplies prior_temperature=1.5 and only the binary prior. final_eval selects the final generation's curriculum settings for both players.

loop._player overlays the base game config. Config.MctsConfig distinguishes td_discount from backprop_discount; ParallelDataGenerator.configurePlayer applies backpropDiscount, whose unchanged default is 0.99. The recorded 0.7 discounts training labels only.

ParallelDataGenerator applies the base game's disabled noise, epsilon=0.15, temperature=2, automatic mana tapping, disabled mulligans and duplicate-state retention. Original bestChild chooses the greatest visit count when the root has no noise seed.
PlayConfigLoader is a partial human-play loader and does not define the released evaluation runner's complete settings.
declared_port_changes: The published runner enables opponent-hand encoding. The fair variant disables it and reconstructs only permitted sampled worlds.
The existing reviewed port uses a fresh tree at each received root and synchronous confined neural transport.
The confined CPU backend uses float32; the released run recorded float16.
